titles.en: Mortis Trials Buff Manager - Local and Realms
titles.zh-CN: 死灵试炼 Buff 管理器
titles.zh-TW: 死靈試煉 Buff 管理器

image_type: UI layout renders with sample configurations; not gameplay screenshots

summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay and also supports Realms sessions. Choose Mortis Trials Buffs through the talent-tree UI, using native eligibility rules and a configurable 1–64 selection limit. Independent of Talent Point Manager.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 为前提，同时支持 Realms 联机会话。通过天赋树界面选择死灵试炼 Buff，按原版资格规则筛选，可设置 1–64 项选择上限。与天赋点管理器独立。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 為前提，同時支援 Realms 聯機會話。透過天賦樹介面選擇死靈試煉 Buff，按原版資格規則篩選，可設定 1–64 項選擇上限。與天賦點管理器獨立。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay and also supports Realms sessions. Choose Mortis Trials Buffs through the talent-tree UI, using native eligibility rules and a configurable 1–64 selection limit. Independent of Talent Point Manager.
